components.name: Button
components.description:
Buttons with real hierarchy: two colour treatments, three tiers, one
primary per view. Labels are DM Sans 16px, sentence case, never Unique. One job per
state: hover and focus-visible roll the label, active presses the
primary down a little; a button never lifts on hover (lift is for cards).
components.rendersAs: a button, or one anchor with href
usage: Hero CTA
Card 'Read more' action
Form submit
Contact send
Nav call to action (shape pill)
The primary contact CTA reads "Let's talk" (brand refresh, 2026-09-22)
dont: Do not render more than one primary per view: the flat ink plate is the single main action
Do not use for filters, toggles, or sort: that is FilterChip / SegmentedControl / Select territory
Do not set labels in Unique at any size
Do not build a neutral tier: it is retired
Do not lift a button on hover: lift is reserved for cards; hover is the label roll
Do not add the trace ring to a button: the trace is Card's affordance
components.restNote: One job per state. At rest the primary is a calm flat plate and a label: no gloss, no key edge, no shadow. Hover and focus-visible roll the label and shift the colour on every tier (primary plate, secondary fill, tertiary label); the button never lifts. Active is a small press down, primary only. Reduced motion: colour only, the shift stays and the roll and press drop. audit:quality asserts the invariants on every story rendering the component (root carries data-bella-component=button).
components.a11y: Verified 8 Nov 2026 (shared look): primary label 13.90:1 on the plate in both modes, and 9.01:1 light / 9.54:1 dark on the hover plate (AAA). Secondary label 16.13:1 light / 14.98:1 dark on the card. Control border 5.16:1 light / 5.13:1 dark on the card. Focus ring 3px, 3px offset, ink in light and near-white in dark: 15.04:1 and 16.26:1 on the page. Focus-visible only.

components.name: Card
components.description:
The one-card system: every card surface renders through this. At rest
it wears shadow.card over surface-card and a faint border (Colour B,
2026-10-04; peek stays flat), theme-aware by
construction; only interactive cards lift on hover and focus. The only
fixed-light path is Peek, on purpose.
components.rendersAs: a div; with href one anchor, with onClick one button
usage: Portfolio grid
Case-study cards
CHIP idea clusters
Dashboard tiles
dont: Do not nest cards inside cards
Do not use for navigation, that's nav-link's job
Do not nest links or buttons inside an interactive card: the card is ONE link or ONE button
Do not build a fixed-dark card, no fixed-dark path exists; peek (fixed always-light paper on navy) is the one recorded fixed-context exception
components.restNote: The rest state is a contract (Colour B, Elleta, 2026-10-04; flat from 2026-09-19): only these layers may paint before hover/focus, and the shadow at rest is exactly shadow.card (peek re-scopes it to none and stays flat). audit:quality asserts the invariants on every story that renders the component (root carries data-bella-component=card).
components.a11y: Interactive cards render as a single anchor or button: one tab stop, no nested interactives. Name a card via ariaLabel when its visible content isn't the right name; media is aria-hidden when ariaLabel is set. Focus shows a visible ring (asserted in CI, both themes). Every card wears shadow.card at rest (peek stays flat); only interactive cards lift on hover and focus; prefers-reduced-motion keeps them still (the shadow still marks hover and focus). Card text sits on surface-card: text-muted 4.64:1 light / 6.03:1 dark, the worst pair (AA).

parts.title: Rest shadow
parts.detail: every card but peek (re-scoped to none), Colour B, 2026-10-04

components.name: Icon
components.description:
The only way BELLA renders an icon. Iconoir glyphs from the registry
(one set, declared), sized by the icon ramp, always currentColor so the
themed ink recolours them for free. Decorative by default; a meaningful
icon requires the label prop and never stands without text unless its
accessible name is proven in a Behavior story.
usage: Segment glyphs
The Select chevron
Any leading icon slot
dont: Do not put id attributes inside an icon SVG: the glyph renders more than once (the Button label roll duplicates it), so an id-referenced gradient or clip would collide; draw with paths and currentColor only (audit:quality enforces)
Do not mix icon sets or draw one-off SVGs: Iconoir is the ONLY source (declared 2026-07-22) and every glyph lives in the registry, nothing inline (audit:quality enforces)
Do not import an icon library component surface: the registry carries the paths BELLA ships (borrow-behavior-only, recorded)
Do not hardcode an icon colour: currentColor inherits the themed ink
Do not let a meaningful icon stand without text unless its accessible name is proven in a Behavior story; decorative is the default and needs no name
components.restNote: Static glyph. audit:quality has no elevation to assert; the invariants hold trivially.
components.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: aria-hidden by default (decorative); with label, role=img plus aria-label. Colour is always currentColor, so contrast rides on the text token of the context. Sizes from the icon tokens (sm 16 / md 20 / lg 24), stroke from icon.stroke.
